translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Anutu Wane Gege Eaŋo Sogi Gege Yuankamaike
Anutu wane papa togon welaine ŋei natne, Parisi, so Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei natne, Skribe, eŋe Yerusalem ŋine sari Yesu wano lewaŋgoi.
Eŋe Yesu dokoine onbi meteene mi saukeu libe qeke, eŋe yaup ŋara ma nekoi.

Parisi so Yuda ŋei ŋerep korop eŋe aso ŋabo eŋane masi ea mogare ge okanmaŋkoi. Eŋe ŋara nekeiwane okane more aso ŋabo ra rokop don yale rake, yalewaka eŋane rokoune ma more meteene sauke more maine ne okangoi.

So nalu qole qoleo ari more zinge sari ŋara nekeiwane okane more eŋe doku tau more ne okangoi. Eŋe kine kine natne aso ŋabo eŋane masi ea korop mogare okan waremaŋkoi. Eŋe lase, kap ŋara mire ne, so kulu papa wane kine kine korop sauke mauluke gemaŋkoi.
Eŋe Yesu qesonka rakoi, “Onoka wane dokoŋone eŋe asoŋabo eŋane numa tego ea mi mogatmami. Eŋe meteene mi sauke more ŋara yaup ma nemami.”
Rauso, eŋe iwa yale edange, “Isaiaŋo ŋine isi ŋei zok ŋidorake, ŋinane kineŋine papiao iwa yale Anutu wane dongo qeke pamaike.

content.text: ‘Anutuŋo rake, Ŋei tego yewa eŋe pieneŋoka naŋane eŋetne nora bukeu waokanmaike. Ŋo, wet derereteneŋo yemo na qeliŋnane more, amaŋ okoramami.
Eŋe nae yaup eŋetneka nora bukeu waokanmaike. Eŋe aso ŋabo eŋane numa tego yewa kito ebone more raokanmami, iwa Anutu wane don.’”

content: Yesu eŋe koso edane rake, “Ŋine Anutu wane don masi koboboine mo qeligeu siuk ŋunmaike? Pakimo, ŋine ŋei ŋinŋine aso ŋabo eŋane don eaka malipka gemami.”
Yesu eŋe koso edange, “Ŋine zok detluke more Anutu wane don koboboine ea matali qetali okane more ŋinŋine asoŋabo eŋane numa tego malipka gemami.
Moseŋo sogino qei bano mo rake, ‘Ŋine nabok magak ere qesiŋore more geokanikei, Ŋo, ŋei mane eŋe nabok magak don borikine etaniakeo, eŋe qeu seukeake.’

Ŋo, ŋine, Anutu wane papa togon welaine ŋei, ŋei ŋerep masi kine mane iwa yale edanmami. Ŋei mane eŋe wesiinerop nagamagaine qesiŋ osiakane okane, ŋo, siluŋ etane raokanmaike, na mo Anutu wane biŋek qile.
Ŋine yale edanbi, eŋe naga magaene mi qesiŋone more, qeliŋ onmaŋkei.
Ŋine ŋinŋine asoŋabo kito ebo ebon ŋei ŋerep ea edanmami, ŋine Anutu wane don zonomine mau kito okanmaike. Ŋine kine kine loutne yalewa ma okanmami.”
Kine Kine Iwaŋo Maki Ŋei Dienerop Okanmaŋkei
Yesu eŋe koso ŋei ŋerep magu suaine edoraki sariu edange, “Ŋine koropŋo naŋane don iwa dere more wetŋineŋo motpi so detlukkeu.

Ŋine detmami, kine kine iwa diinerop ŋadino pamaike, eaŋo ŋinane kotoŋine mi maki sigileake. Ŋo kine kine natne ŋinane wet dereretŋine kotino pamaike, eaŋo saket more maki wet dereretŋine korop sigile okanmaike.
Ŋei mane eŋe wetineropŋo don iwa detlukkeake.
Yale ra more eŋe ŋei ŋerep yewa qeliŋone more eŋine so dokoine eŋe ari mat maneo wa more don rokop rake yewa wane kine desikeiwane qesonkakoi.”
Yesu eŋe iwa yale edange, “Ŋinane dereretŋineŋo ŋei ŋerep natne eŋane dereret mi yuan onmaike. Ŋara kine kine korop pamaike, eaŋo ne more ŋei ŋerep mi sigilekene.
Ŋara yewa wet dereretŋine mi qeduguyake. Ŋara qomŋino ket more koso kaŋinoka saket ariake.” Iwa yale Yesu eŋe ŋara kine kine yewa eŋe korop Anutu wane kaitko libekaka pamaike.
Pakiso, eŋe rake, “Kine kine ŋei wet dereret kotino pamaike, eaŋo saket more maki ŋei ŋerep wet dereretŋine korop sigile okanmaike.

Ŋei ŋerep wet dereretko pa more saket maki ŋei ŋerep dirop okan okanmaine yemo iwa, edo dereret qotkoine detokanmami, so ŋei ŋerep natewen qaluwit wenip yauyaup ma okanmami, so ŋei naka pilaŋŋo engu mamami me kine kineŋo matalionbi seuke okanmami, kobu ma okanmami,

ŋei mane eŋe ŋei mane wane ŋanomine kobu ma okanmaike, bailalaŋ okan okanmami. Ŋine masi tanik kine kine natne korop okan okanmami, isi kine kine ma okanmami, wawaine masi kine kine okan okanmami, bau wawa masi kine kine ma okanmami, qe baik ma baik don ra okanmami, wawaine don kine kine ra okanmami, doku togole ne more qelaŋ qelaŋine okan numa kine kine mau bori okanmaike.
Masi tanik kine kine qotkoine korop iwaŋo ŋei ŋerep wet dereretko pa more eaŋo saket maki ŋei ŋerep dienerop okan okanmami.”
Ŋerep Mane Eŋane Malip Malipine Togole
Yesu eŋe yewa qelige ea ŋine wie Tire matko ari lotke more, mat mane wane kotino ari waket siuke metke, onoka wane ŋei ŋerep edo esatka eŋano mi sari lewaŋgei wane. Ŋo siluŋ dalino siuke metkirap.
Mida! Ŋerep mane mat yewa ŋine eŋe Yesu mo detkaki metke. Ŋerep yewa eŋe borasine asu qotkoineŋo matalikaki metke, ea wane ŋerep yewa eŋe ikopka sari Yesu wane osino kino ket pese wawetine qeke.

Ŋerep yewa eŋe tego maneo ŋine, qelaŋ ŋerep, eŋe Yuda wane tegooŋine mida. Eŋe Ponisia tegoo ŋine, kepe mat ea wane welaine, eamo Siria kepeo. Eŋe Yesu wano ari seleleine qe meŋenka more rake, “Borasone asu qotkoineŋo matalikaki metmaike. Ge esopkanom!”
Yesu eŋe olale rake, “Ŋene mikepka medep ŋara gumeonŋem. Ŋene medep eŋane ŋara maine mi biraŋem kasimde eŋano ariake.”
Yale rakiso, ŋerep eŋe mainge rake, “Waom, ge don wele ramaine, ŋo medep eŋe ŋara ne okanmami, naso yewao sisine kepo ketki kasi eŋe medep eŋane ŋara sisine ea ma ne okanmaŋkei.”
Pakiso, Yesu eŋe ŋerep olatke, “Ge yale ramaine, ea wane maine zinge arinom borasoŋone asu qotkoine ea mo qeliŋ kamaike.”
Yale ra olatki, ŋerep eŋe zinge matko ari kaki borasine ea asu qotkoineŋo mo welekatne qeliŋka saket ariki eŋe maine papaino kulu pake.
Yesu Eŋe Ŋei Mane Aŋa Ketine Won Wole Ma Menaŋkake.
Yesu eŋe wie Tire qelige more Sidon kepe so Mat Suaine Meteetke(10) kepe keuoka ratoke ari Galili doku namugo lotkeke.
Ŋei natne eŋe ŋei mane done mi raraine so ketine won wole ea Yesu wano iwenka sari oŋo metine more ma menaŋ kayakane olatkoi.
Pakiso, Yesu eŋe ŋei yewa maki eretneka ŋei ŋerep magu yewa qeliŋone amaŋ ari mere so Yesuŋo ŋei yewa wane ketino metine boineŋo qesikane more, mekatine boino sopotke belakamino motke.
More so qeliwo potki waki wetine aroke saki, rake, “Epata!” Don ea wane kine iwa yale. “Ketŋone so aŋaŋone lotkeuk!”
Yale raki ŋei yewa dereretine lotkeki korop detkake. So belakamine umareke, ea ewekki don maine rake.

Yesu eŋe sari ŋei ŋerep magu yewa rawetone more rake, “Masi iwa mamaile, ea wane don sigi misuk rau sua ariake.” Yale ra naso baŋem rawetone okanmaŋke, ŋo, eŋe soringe takotke eŋane don sigi rau sua arimaŋke.

Ŋei ŋerep korop eŋe oŋaene qaeki rakoi, “Urata kine kine natne welekatne wakonmaike. Ŋo, Yesu eŋe ŋei ketine won wole ea maki lotkeki don detlukmaike. So eŋe ŋei aŋaine umatne so mawon mawole, ea maki don ramaike.”
